topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: Ongoing fees or expenses are charges you pay regularly, such as an annual account maintenance fee, even if there are no transactions in your account.
question: Misconception: An investment adviser charges an annual advisory fee only when they make trades in my portfolio.
answer: An advisory fee may be an ongoing charge based on the value of your portfolio, so it can apply even when there are no transactions. Check the fee disclosures or ask your adviser how the fee is calculated.
